name: Alethorpe
type: locality; civil parish; deserted medieval village
text: Alethorpe is a deserted medieval village site and former civil parish, now in the parish of Little Snoring, Norfolk, England. It is south-east of Little Snoring, around 2 miles (3.2 km) north-east of Fakenham and 23 miles (37 km) north-west of Norwich, north of A148 road. The village is one of around 200 lost settlements in Norfolk.

depictions.name: Alethorp
depictions.text: Alethorp (Runic: ᛅᛚᛅᚦᚬᚱᛒ) was a dwarven village in Vangrinn, Svartálfaheimr. During the Muspel invasion, the mill was taken over by both jötnar and Muspel warriors.
